_comment: The Hearth (prompt 08 §2, magic/hearth.py, docs/HEARTH.md). companions: who sits by the fire, from when (joins_after: a guardian beaten), and the script node of each talk in data/story/hearth.script (the node's own <<if>> lines choose what is said, on story variables and fatigue). letters: one per region, arriving at the Hearth once its guardian is beaten (after); the text is the node in data/story/letters.script. burnout: the companion who collapses when the party leaves the Hearth this many times in a row without sleeping. backups: how many named world backups the shelf keeps.
